description:
The contractor must be an APC-certified service provider and shall
provide all resources necessary to accomplish the deliverables described in this
Statement of Work (SOW), except as otherwise specified. The contractor will perform
on-site repairs, semi-annual maintenance, and emergency repair services, including
24x7 emergency support, for the APC UPS and InRow cooling units at the Department
of Veterans Affairs, 444 W. Fort Street, Boise, ID, 83702. Services include, but are not
limited to, inspections, certifications, and repairs, per manufacturer specifications and
industry standards.
